lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, with the largest spots concentrated along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Narrow vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot rows, creating a lattice-like structure where spots are positioned within the rectangular cells or at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the mid-flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light-reflective upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible V-shaped notch or irregularity is present on the posterior trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, lower-luminance spots relative to the flank patterning; a human-shaped silhouette is visible in the upper background.
